templates.question: How do I create and edit a template?
templates.answer: In Templates you can create a template, add content, variables, images, headers and footers, and edit it again later.

variables.question: How do template variables work?
variables.answer: Variables are fields completed while generating a document. They can contain text, dates, selections or images and may be reused in the document.

documents.question: Will editing a template change an existing document?
documents.answer: No. A generated document keeps its saved content. Later template changes do not modify existing documents.

pdf.question: Why can PDF preview take a moment to load?
pdf.answer: The PDF is generated on demand from the document, so the first preview can take a moment. The PDF preview is the reference for the downloaded file.

billing.question: Where can I find plan and payment information?
billing.answer: Your current plan, validity, payment method and sales documents are available in Settings.

account.question: How do I change account details or my password?
account.answer: Account data can be edited in Account, while preferences and account security are available from your profile sections.

email.question: Can I use a document template as an email?
email.answer: Yes. From Documents choose “Prepare email”, select any template and complete its variables. You can enter an optional subject and copy the formatted message into Gmail, Outlook or another email client. Direct sending requires voluntarily configuring your own email account in Settings.

calculations.question: How do calculated numeric variables work?
calculations.answer: Calculated numbers use formulas made from numbers and numeric variables. Open the calculated variables tutorial for examples, supported operators and an interactive playground.

help.calculationsDescription: Learn how to build formulas from numbers and numeric variables, validate them and preview the result.

calculationHelp.title: Calculated numeric variables
calculationHelp.description: Create numeric values from constants, NUMBER variables and other calculations.
calculationHelp.syntax: Use +, -, *, /, %, parentheses and decimal numbers. Only NUMBER and calculated numeric variables can be inserted into a formula.
calculationHelp.validation: DocFlow checks missing variables, non-numeric variables, unsupported operators, invalid syntax and circular calculation dependencies before the formula is used.
calculationHelp.tryDescription: Enter a formula with numbers and see the result immediately.
calculationHelp.aggregates: SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX and COUNT can use both numeric fields and results of other calculations. If the source is inside a repeating table, the function processes values from all rows.
calculationHelp.chain: A calculation can use another calculation result. Example: Net price and VAT calculate Gross price in each row, then SUM(GrossPrice) calculates Amount due. DocFlow resolves dependencies in order and blocks cycles.
calculationHelp.formats: Numeric fields and calculations can be displayed as a number, currency, percentage or measurement. Formatting does not change the numeric value used by calculations.
calculationHelp.empty: SUM of an empty set returns 0. Empty cells are skipped by aggregates. An invalid numeric value causes a calculation error instead of silently replacing the result.
calculationHelp.tableExample: In every row: NetPrice + VAT → GrossPrice. Outside the table: SUM(GrossPrice) → AmountDue. GrossPrice may itself be a calculated field; it does not have to be a plain numeric field.
